acceptance: A directory run over results-data reports no non-bundle file as FAIL; a test covers the inventory file.
A file that is a malformed bundle still fails.
context: Found while fixing integrity-validator-false-failures-20261114. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.
description: Problem: a directory run of `benchbox results validate` over results-data includes results-data/corpus-inventory.json, which is an index, not a result bundle, so it always shows as FAIL. The command already skips *.manifest.json; it should also skip, or recognise, other non-bundle JSON.
